Target / packet: `ai-random-vs-grid-search` · `D1`. Prerequisites: none; all arithmetic explained locally.

Nearest / distinct payoff: `compute-optimal-scaling` → `ai-compute-optimal-scaling` (earlier admitted draft or same-packet identity; not independent clearance). Unlike optimizing parameters/tokens under a product resource constraint, this allocates a finite trial budget across relevant and irrelevant hyperparameters and shows a losing random draw.

Primary finite model: Toy objective f(x,y)=1-abs(x-.6) ignores y. Budget4: 2×2 grid x∈{0,1},y∈{0,1} best.6 with2 unique x; fixed random trial x=[.1,.4,.6,.9] with y=[.8,.2,.5,.1] best1 with4 unique x.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict which trial reaches the optimum; recall when varying irrelevant y consumes a grid budget without new x.
